
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/p/23693427" title="发布于 2026-11-17 14:19">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">java 多线程开发系列之十一：线程池的拒绝策略</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">线程池是一个资源调度池，我们可以将需要做的任务直接丢到线程池中，关于线程池的简介可以看前文的这篇文章：</span></p>
<p><em><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">java 多线程开发系列之九：玩转线程池（线程池的简介和简单使用） https://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/p/23471356</span></em></p>
<p><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">考虑到硬件资源以及任务的时限性，线程池中的任务并不能无限加，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )而且即使资源无限，也并不代表可以承载的待执行任务越多越好，至于原因，我下文中会提到。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">我们可以通过线程数和任务队列来控制可执行的最大任务数量=正在执行+待执行。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">当任务数已经超过线程池的最大任务数时，线程池会依据一段预定的执行逻辑来处理这个超限任务。而这一段预定的执行逻辑通过接口实现类嵌入到线程池中。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">这段包含执行实现的接口实例，我们称之为拒绝策略。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">java为拒绝策略声明了一个接口，并提供了4个常用的策略实现。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">接口如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RejectedExecutionHandler {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rejectedExecution(Runnable r, ThreadPoolExecutor executor);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> }</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">拒绝任务执行的逻辑有两个参数，</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">1，runnable，待执行的任务</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">2，ThreadPoolExecutor ，当前线程池</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">有人看到这个源码会疑惑，线程池除了可以提交runnable任务，不也可以提交callable任务嘛。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">对于callable任务，这里不就没法传了么？</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">其实翻看submit源码我就可以看到，在提交callable任务时，callable 的任务被进一步包装为RunnableFuture提交的，而RunnableFuture又是继承了</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">Runnable接口的。所以参数1也是可以持有到callable任务的。（线程池内部的执行逻辑后边有精力慢慢总结，内部其实非常复杂。）</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">在使用多线程中，我们常常会根据不同的场景需要，配置不同的拒绝策略实例。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">依次来看下这四个拒绝策略实例：</span><br><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（1）AbortPolicy   中止策略</span></strong><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">Abort </span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px"><em>美 [əˈbɔː (r)t]，英 [əˈbɔː (r)t]，</em></span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px"><em>v. 中止；流产；放弃；堕胎；</em></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">这个策略的作用是终止当前提交的任务，直接丢弃掉，并抛出一个运行时异常告知任务提交者。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">它是线程池的默认处理策略。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">来看源码：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> AbortPolicy <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">implements</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RejectedExecutionHandler {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>  
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AbortPolicy() { }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>  
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rejectedExecution(Runnable r, ThreadPoolExecutor e) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RejectedExecutionException("Task " + r.toString() +
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>                                                  " rejected from " +
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                                                 e.toString());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     }</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（2）DiscardPolicy 丢弃策略</span></strong><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">这个策略就是丢弃当前任务，什么都不做，实现也是一段空逻辑。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> DiscardPolicy <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">implements</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RejectedExecutionHandler {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DiscardPolicy() { }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rejectedExecution(Runnable r, ThreadPoolExecutor e) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span>     }</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（3）DiscardOldestPolicy 丢弃最老策略</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">将任务队列待执行的任务中，最早的一个丢弃掉。重新尝试执行该任务。(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )注意丢弃老任务后，仍然需要重新提交可能仍会被其它任务抢先提交成功。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> DiscardOldestPolicy <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">implements</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RejectedExecutionHandler {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DiscardOldestPolicy() { }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rejectedExecution(Runnable r, ThreadPoolExecutor e) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">e.isShutdown()) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                e.getQueue().poll();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                e.execute(r);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     }</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（4）CallerRunsPolicy 调用者运行策略</span></strong><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">这个策略是由提交该任务的线程自己执行这个任务。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">注意由于拒绝执行的方法rejectedExecution()是由任务提交者执行的，因此这里直接使用run方法，而非start()方法。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> CallerRunsPolicy <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">implements</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RejectedExecutionHandler {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CallerRunsPolicy() { }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rejectedExecution(Runnable r, ThreadPoolExecutor e) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">e.isShutdown()) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                r.run();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     }</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">注意这四种线程池内置的拒绝策略，没有孰好孰坏。他们有各自的使用场景。</span><br><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">AbortPolicy 中止策略</span></strong><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">适用于提交者需要明确感知任务提交是否成功的场景。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">比如用户提交了创建任务，需要明确知道任务创建的任务到底有没有提交成功。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">或者金融转账提交</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">亦或者用户下单购买商品，先不说是否超卖或者被审计驳回，首先创建任务的申请到底提交成功了没有，用户需要感知。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">DiscardPolicy 丢弃策略</span></strong><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">这个策略通常用来处理，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )线程丢就丢了无所谓的旁路任务提交。比如有兜底任务保证的同步子任务。没执行也没关系，有同步兜底检查。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">DiscardOldestPolicy 丢弃最老策略</span></strong><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">这个策略通常用来更新实时数据，比如采集数据什么的。相当于通过旧数据淘汰机制，对新数据起到一定的保护作用。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">比如实时的温度传感数据，通常大家更关心最新的数据，新数据的优先级远大于旧数据。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">CallerRunsPolicy 调用者运行策略</span></strong><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">这个策略通常用来处理任务不能随意丢弃的场景。并且由于调用者自身执行了任务。从而对线程池天然起到了限流作用（注意这是一把双刃剑）。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">消费者消费消息时，通常会用到这个策略。但是这个策略也有天然劣势，由于提交线程本身不再受到线程池的停止动作的约束。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">而且也会导致职责不明，本来是上游的任务提交者，结果又变为了下游任务处理者。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">当任务处理非常缓慢阻塞时，导致上游的消费出现问题。当大规模任务阻塞时，异步变同步，导致整个调用链路全部阻塞。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">线程池从原来的资源池变为了临时的“蓄水池”，异步的优势荡然无存。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">同时这种策略实际执行时，如果有用到ThreaLocal，还可能导致提交线程的ThreadLocal被污染。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">以上是java线程池提供的四种策略，在实际生产中，通常会借鉴上述思路，实现自定义策略。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（1）对于核心业务的主路分支，我们不能随意丢弃，也不希望影响到任务提交者。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">当触发拒绝策略时，先入MQ，异步消费MQ后再次提交，多次提交仍然未果，进入死信队列或者入库，等工作人员手动触发或审核。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（2）对于非核心业务即使丢弃，也要进行日志记录，入库或者入kafka等，保证可追溯。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">最后来看一个自定义策略的例子：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-size: 13px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> MyRejectPolicyStudy <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">implements</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RejectedExecutionHandler {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    @Override
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rejectedExecution(Runnable r, ThreadPoolExecutor executor) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>         System.out.println("exec Reject policy's thread is " +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Thread.currentThread().getName());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>         Thread t = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Thread(r);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>         t.setName("临时线程"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        t.start();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> main(String[] args) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ExecutionException, InterruptedException {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>         ThreadPoolExecutor executor = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ThreadPoolExecutor(1, 1, 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, TimeUnit.SECONDS,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> SynchronousQueue&lt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>         executor.setRejectedExecutionHandler(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyRejectPolicyStudy());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>         Callable&lt;Integer&gt; task1 = () -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>             TimeUnit.SECONDS.sleep(2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>             System.out.println("exec task1 thread is " +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Thread.currentThread().getName());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>         Callable&lt;Integer&gt; task2 = () -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>             TimeUnit.SECONDS.sleep(2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span>             System.out.println("exec task2 thread is " +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Thread.currentThread().getName());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span>         Future&lt;Integer&gt; submit1 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> executor.submit(task1);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span>         Future&lt;Integer&gt; submit2 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> executor.submit(task2);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span>         Integer rtn1 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> submit1.get();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span>         System.out.println("task 1 ,result=" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rtn1);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span>         Integer rtn2 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> submit2.get();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">31</span>         System.out.println("task 2 ,result=" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rtn2);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">32</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span> }</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">结果如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-size: 13px">exec Reject policy's thread is main
exec task1 thread is pool-1-thread-1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
exec task2 thread is 临时线程
task </span>1 ,result=1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
task </span>2 ,result=2</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">我们可以得出以下结论：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">1、拒绝策略的rejectedExecution()是由提交者执行的，在这里是main线程，前文也有提到，查看源码也可以进一步确认。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">2、只要任务submit后，我们通过返回的future对象获取到任务句柄（handler），后边无论是哪个线程（线程池线程还是其它线程）真正执行了该任务，</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">我们都可以从future中拿到任务结果（或取消任务）。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">再回到文章开头说到任务不是容纳的任务越多越好这个问题，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )有时我们希望提交的任务可以尽快的执行或者被响应，如果线程池容纳的任务非常多，就会导致待执行的任务越来越多，新提交的线程就总是不会被快速的响应到。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">要明白拒绝策略是一种反馈，我们不应该将其认为是系统能力不行的一种消极处理机制，更不应该认为拒绝策略总是不好的。</span></p>

</div>
